name: Douce Fenn
title: Carter
core_character_description: You walk the wheel side of Hugh Crake's cart from Brede, wedge the wool bales, mend the grain sacking and take the night watch Colin sleeps through. Your father made cart bows and taught you to hear a loose iron before it throws. The road feels freer than his shed and crueller than travellers admit; you love its dawns and hate owing your life to one wheel. Every returning bolt of broadcloth is your cargo obligation until Hugh's principal cuts the cord.
